gist: Sensei promised Yuuka last night he would sit with her through the whole Seminar budget audit and vouch for the receipts; he turned down a dinner invitation and stayed until nine, hunting down missing receipts with her.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:10] Sensei, tonight's audit. Seminar office, 16:00. You said last night you'd sit in and vouch for the receipts. I'm holding you to it.
[user:sensei 07:12] I'll be there. 16:00, I wrote it down.
[you 07:13] Write it in ink. The auditor does not accept "I forgot" as a line item.
[user:sensei 07:14] Ink. Go eat breakfast.
[you 07:15] I have. Half a rice ball counts.
[user:sensei 07:16] It does not.
[you 11:40] Question. Did you buy the stapler in the supply closet, or did it appear?
[user:sensei 11:42] I bought it. Receipt is in the blue folder.
[you 11:43] ...Good. That's one less hole.
[user:sensei 13:20] Sorry, heads up: Vice-Principal Kotori's office just invited me to the faculty dinner tonight. Free meal, 18:30.
[you 13:21] That's during the audit.
[user:sensei 13:22] I know. I told them I can't. I already promised someone.
[you 13:23] ...Fine. Eat something before 16:00, then.
### chat:huddle:w4n8k2d7qe
# {DAY}
[you 16:02] *sets the blue folder and a stack of receipts on the table*
[user:sensei] Sorry, the corridor was full. I'm here.
[you] [face=calm] Two minutes late and I'm not counting it. Sit. The auditor from the council arrives at 16:30.
[noa-ushio 16:31] [face=content] Good afternoon, Yuuka. Sensei. I'll be taking the council's seat for this audit.
[noa-ushio] Opening line: the club account shows 38,000 yen spent in October. Receipts, please.
[you] Here. Forty-one of forty-three. Two are missing, both from the 19th.
[user:sensei 16:45] Those are mine. I paid for the printer ink and the folders from my own wallet on the 19th. I'll find the paper.
[noa-ushio] If they are not found, the 6,400 yen comes out of the Seminar fund as unexplained.
[you] [face=flustered] ...It won't come to that.
[user:sensei 17:50] *pulls his coat off the chair and goes through the pockets again*
[user:sensei] Not here. I'm checking the shop's online order history. Give me twenty minutes.
[noa-ushio 18:30] The audit closes at 19:00 per the council's schedule, Sensei.
[user:sensei 18:40] Found it. Emailed copy, shop stamp, dated the 19th. Printing now.
[you] *takes the page and checks the total against the ledger twice*
[you 18:55] Forty-three of forty-three. The ledger balances.
[noa-ushio 19:00] Audit closed, no findings. Good work, both of you.
[noa-ushio] *leaves, heading toward Millennium Lecture Building*
[you 19:05] Sensei. You're pale. Did you eat?
[user:sensei] Not since the stapler. It's fine.
[you] That was lunch, not dinner. Wait here.
[you 19:10] *comes back with two convenience-store bentos and puts one in front of him*
[you] Eat. Don't make a speech about it.
[you] [face=calm] The faculty dinner was free. This is 580 yen. Receipt, Sensei, for the records.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 21:15] Home. Tomorrow I'm reconciling the November book before first bell.
[user:sensei 21:16] Go to sleep before that.
[you 21:17] I'll consider it.
